# GitHub Labels Reference

This document outlines the standard labels used for issues and pull requests in Career Atelier.

---

## Type Labels

| Name | Description | Color |
|---|---|---|
| `type: bug` | Something is not working as expected | `#d73a4a` |
| `type: feature` | New feature or enhancement request | `#a2eeef` |
| `type: documentation` | Improvements or additions to documentation | `#0075ca` |
| `type: refactor` | Code restructuring without behavior changes | `#cfd3d7` |

---

## Area Labels

| Name | Description | Color |
|---|---|---|
| `area: web` | Next.js frontend application (`web/`) | `#1d76db` |
| `area: runner` | Local CLI runner and execution process (`runner/`) | `#5319e7` |
| `area: database` | Supabase schema, migrations, and RLS policies | `#3ecf8e` |
| `area: harness` | Agent orchestration, context packs, and schemas | `#fbca04` |
| `area: mcp` | Local MCP server implementation (`runner/mcp/`) | `#0e8a16` |

---

## Provider Labels

| Name | Description | Color |
|---|---|---|
| `provider: codex` | Issues specific to OpenAI Codex CLI | `#10a37f` |
| `provider: claude` | Issues specific to Anthropic Claude Code CLI | `#d97706` |
| `provider: antigravity` | Issues specific to Google Antigravity (agy) CLI | `#4285f4` |

---

## Status & Contribution Labels

| Name | Description | Color |
|---|---|---|
| `good first issue` | Good for newcomers to the project | `#7057ff` |
| `help wanted` | Extra attention or community contribution is welcomed | `#008672` |
| `status: waiting for feedback` | Waiting on response from the author or reporter | `#e4e669` |
| `status: blocked` | Blocked by external dependencies or upstream behavior | `#b60205` |
